name: Port of Messina (Terminal Crociere Messina)
body_of_water: Strait of Messina / Ionian & Tyrrhenian Seas
overview_text: Messina is Sicily's key northeastern cruise gateway, located directly along the scenic Strait of Messina. The terminal exits straight onto the city waterfront road.
getting_around: The city center and Piazza del Duomo are a flat 5-10 minute walk (500m) from the port exit. Messina Centrale railway station is a 10-minute walk south with frequent trains to Taormina.
all_aboard_warning: If taking trains or private tours to Taormina (~50 km south), account for the uphill shuttle connection from Taormina-Giardini train station and allow at least 60-75 minutes of travel buffer.

terminals.name: Terminal Crociere Messina
terminals.location: Via Vittorio Emanuele II / Banchina Colapesce
terminals.description: Compact, modern passenger terminal providing streamlined customs and security screenings directly at the waterfront.
terminals.source: Port Authority of the Strait of Messina (adspstretto.it)

berths.name: Banchina Colapesce (Berths I & II)
berths.notes: 350-meter-long continuous concrete quay with deep 10-12 meter drafts accommodating the largest cruise ships alongside.
berths.source: Port Authority of the Strait of Messina Berth Specification

arrival_procedures: Direct alongside docking. Passengers exit the gangway straight into the terminal building for a brief security/customs scan, and exit immediately onto the waterfront road (Via Vittorio Emanuele II).
departure_procedures: Extremely fast processing. Due to the simple port footprint, check-in and security clearances are completed in minutes. Taxis and tour operators stage directly at the port exit.

walking_feasibility.description: One of the most central cruise docks in the Mediterranean. Piazza del Duomo and the astronomical clock tower are a flat 5-10 minute walk (approx. 500 meters) straight from the terminal exit.

provenance.verification_authority: Port Authority of the Strait of Messina & Comune di Messina 2026
